# Award-Winning Roofing Contractor

Don't settle for just any roofer. Choose a roofing contractor who has a proven history of excellence! We have been the recipient of several awards over the years. We also belong to several community organizations.Contact us at our Nanticoke or Dickson City Office when you're ready for great roofing from a local business!

![Awards](https://le-cdn.hibuwebsites.com/983869aca4494363a1e28ddf9dfabe34/dms3rep/multi/opt/11716264+%281%29-1920w.jpg)

### Winner of Excalibur Award

Excalibur Awards are given to the “Top 60 Roofing Contractors in the United States.” Pinnacle Roofing & Sheet Metal, Inc. has earned an Excalibur Award every year from 1994 to current year. This is an honor awarded to Versico’s most prominent and successful authorized contractors.

### Associations

We are proud members of the Northeastern Pennsylvania Contractors Association, the National Roofing Contractors Association, and the Wilkes Barre, Scranton, and Hazleton Chambers of Commerce.
